title: silene dioica subsp. glutinosa
intro: Silene dioica subsp. glutinosa, commonly known as Red Campion, is a plant species that belongs to the Caryophyllaceae family. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine, where its health benefits include treating coughs, respiratory issues, and digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Red Campion are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and soothe respiratory tract irritation. Bioactive constituents present in Red Campion include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to confirm its full potential.
